Developers · Quickstart

Your first call in three steps.

Zenith Tokens speaks the OpenAI API. If your code already works with OpenAI, change the base URL and the key.

Create an account →Full API reference ↗

On this page

1. Get a key2. Make a call3. Use it in appsHelp

1. Get a key

Create an account on Zenith Tokens, open the console and create an API key. You can set a quota, an expiry and the models each key may call.

Base URL: https://tokens.aitist.ai/v1

2. Make a call

With curl or the OpenAI Python SDK:

curl · OpenAI-compatible
curl https://tokens.aitist.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZENITH_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello, Zenith"}]
  }'
python · openai SDK
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="https://tokens.aitist.ai/v1",
    api_key="sk-...",  # create a key in the console
)

reply = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="zai-org/GLM-5.3",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Summarize this repo."}],
    stream=True,
)
for chunk in reply:
    print(chunk.choices[0].delta.content or "", end="")

Any model on the models page works. Copy the model name exactly, for example moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro.

3. Use it in apps

  • Cherry Studio, CC Switch: use the one-click configuration in the console, or add an OpenAI-compatible provider with the base URL above and your key.
  • Agent frameworks: any framework that accepts an OpenAI base URL works. Streaming uses server-sent events.
  • Monitoring: usage, cost and latency per key appear in the console in real time.

Help
